scope: Three individual 10-axis static source reviews in two independent source families from #677; no public consumer promotion or Q1-Q5 recount. All package Git trees enumerated, not all assets or rights reviewed.

records.name: music-compose
records.source_root_license: MIT (publisher original source only; third-party source images/inputs require independent rights)
records.benefit: Compare different melodies or arrangements without throwing away decisions you already approved.
records.transferable_method: Write a brief, draft the smallest meaningful alternatives, select components with lineage, lock approved choices and hand a structured plan to production.
records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Composition decisions and handoff, not mastered audio, automatic paid generation or permission to modify a person's files.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: Clear scope and excludes final production.
ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: Draft/selection/lock procedure and references are coherent.
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: External audio requires optional Replicate token and paid host authority; file writes lack explicit user confirmation.
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Unresolved handoff decisions handled; helper error/rollback behavior incomplete.
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Provides test case specifications, lineage and structured examples, not actual test receipts.
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Node 22+, Tonal/@tonejs/midi and optional Replicate peer packages not all evaluated.
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Core decision protocol transferable without the model or MIDI tooling.
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Unique component-level decision locks rather than simply another harmony/rhythm recipe.
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: No strong explicit controls over untrusted reference data or overwriting existing output paths.
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No production audition or real composition comparison executed.

hard_fail_or_hold: transpose-midi.ts writeFile(output) can overwrite an existing file (including input) without no-clobber check or output path approval
Replicate and npm installation are not authorized by static inspection
Reference music may be private or copyrighted; do not upload or mimic protected audio blindly
records.license_and_rights: MIT root for author code/docs; package assets metadata observed but examples not all read; reference recordings/music/lyrics and third-party model terms separate.
records.limits: 14 owned files source-tree verified. Eleven source text files read; three example YAML assets observed but not content-reviewed.
records.decision: STATIC REFERENCE-ONLY; no consumer shelf promotion or unchanged package approval
records.source_crosswalk: Full pinned source package tree verified; mirror/alias equivalence with governed index UNKNOWN

records.name: illustration-flat
records.source_root_license: MIT (publisher original source only; third-party source images/inputs require independent rights)
records.benefit: Make simple, repeatable vector pictures for onboarding, empty states and product stories.
records.transferable_method: Choose a restrained palette and one scene metaphor; build an SVG from simple reusable parts; compare at multiple sizes; run an illustration-specific lint before publishing.
records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Flat SVG product illustrations, not full environmental painting, production asset redistribution, or running downloaded render scripts unreviewed.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: Precise flat-vector/UI activation and clear style nontriggers.
ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: Detailed proportion/palette/parts/QA workflow; self-contained SVG target.
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Local scripts write outputs without consent/overwrite safeguards.
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Visual checks and lint are offered, but a failed render may leave artifacts.
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Publisher claims measured/compared examples, with no independently reproduced result.
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Headless render requires Playwright/Chromium; SVG parts kit is Node-specific.
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Planning and SVG craft transferable outside this exact art style.
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Procedural reusable parts and 2x/detail inspection improve reliability.
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Raw SVG placed into page.setContent; regex lint is optional, not a sanitizer or network sandbox.
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No actual image generation, render, accessibility test or human art review executed.

hard_fail_or_hold: render.mjs embeds untrusted SVG directly in Chromium page.setContent with no visible network block or enforced sanitizer; possible script/external asset behavior
lint.mjs regex validation is NOT a complete SVG security sanitizer
writeFileSync in parts demo can clobber a chosen path
Demo screenshots/SVG assets have not received per-file rights clearance
records.license_and_rights: Root MIT covers publisher authored software/docs; examples/preview art ownership is publisher-stated, not independently proven. No bundled raster/vector redistribution proposed.
records.limits: 13 owned files source-tree verified; SKILL, craft rules, key scripts and style read; demo HTML/images/examples/OpenAI YAML not fully reviewed.
records.decision: STATIC REFERENCE-ONLY; no consumer shelf promotion or unchanged package approval
records.source_crosswalk: Full pinned source package tree verified; mirror/alias equivalence with governed index UNKNOWN

records.name: illustration-ink-sketch
records.source_root_license: MIT (publisher original source only; third-party source images/inputs require independent rights)
records.benefit: Create friendly sketch-style illustrated characters with consistent outlines, shading and expressive poses.
records.transferable_method: Use seeded, separately keyed brush marks to preserve style consistency; build one clear character metaphor; review line quality, hatching and visual focus against reference cards.
records.purpose_and_nontrigger: Hand-drawn-look SVG mascots, not original environment concept art or a safe-to-run browser renderer for arbitrary SVG.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: Narrow ink-brush/mascot activation plus adjacent-style exclusions.
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Seeded generator and browser renderer write files without per-action consent.
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Can reroll marks and lint output, but no robust runtime rollback.
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Original demo claims and reference comparisons exist but were not independently validated.
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Node kit plus optional Playwright/Chromium and external renderer assumptions.
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Style rules transferable, while exact seeded kit locks into its implementation.
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Seeded per-mark randomness gives controlled revision without unrelated drift.
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Same unsandboxed raw-SVG browser rendering and regex-only lint exposure.
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No rendered image, visual judgment, screen reader or quality regression check was run.

hard_fail_or_hold: render.mjs passes raw SVG into Chromium without guaranteed active-content filtering or network blocking
ink-kit.mjs svgOut(file) uses writeFileSync with no no-clobber guard
SVG aria-label and generated text are not shown universally escaped
Per-asset demo preview and example rights need separate confirmation
